verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs show it runs post-response scripts and lets you write tests that validate API responses. The evidence does not say which response parts those assertions can target, and a community user calls it invaluable for validating APIs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of assertions on response status, body and headers, an assertion API or syntax reference, hands-on corroboration of header and body checks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write test assertions against response status, body, and headers

citations.quote: Postman can run scripts before a request is sent (pre-request) or after (post-response).
Write scripts to add dynamic behavior to requests and collections. Perform API tests, add dynamic parameters, pass data between requests, and more.
